title: Grilled Shrimp Skewers with German-Style Crunchy Topping
description: A classic German-inspired dish featuring succulent shrimp skewers grilled to perfection and topped with a crunchy mixture of kissed almonds and greek yogurt.
instructions: 2. Thread shrimp onto skewers, leaving a small space between each shrimp.
3. Grill shrimp for 2-3 minutes per side, or until pink and cooked through.
4. Meanwhile, mix together kissed almonds and crunchy crackers in a small bowl.
5. Stir in greek yogurt until well combined.
6. Brush the mixture onto the grilled shrimp skewers.
